messages:
alex.m: heads-up — alert for /v2/prompt-route. Error rate jumped to ~18% in the last 5m, latency doubled. alert: https://internal.ops/alerts/1799992010 :rotating_light:
incident-bot: paging on-call (primary) @sofia via PagerDuty :bell:
sofia: I'm on it, taking ownership. starting quick triage now.
ben: seeing lots of 502/timeout in the router logs. snippet:
```
2026-03-15T02:00:12Z router ERR upstream="prompt-router-experimental:8080" status=502 latency=234ms
```
service deployed ~15m ago. canary weights look odd.
eve: tagging in — I can toggle the FF if needed but need UI or admin token. who has access?
sofia: please toggle router.experimental_v2 off and re-evaluate. we want traffic back to stable. @eve can you run the admin toggle?
eve: running command: `admin-ctl ff set router.experimental_v2 false --source=incident`
```
$ admin-ctl ff set router.experimental_v2 false --source=incident
OK  router.experimental_v2 = false  (applied to env:prod)
Propagation start: 02:02:45Z
```
deploy-bot: Feature flag updated: router.experimental_v2 = false by eve. Rolling routing tables to stable endpoint.
sofia: watching metrics — error rate down from 18% -> 3% in 90s. latency trending back to normal.
alex.m: customer impact: A few enterprise customers reported timeouts in streaming calls, likely between 02:00-02:08 UTC. CS pinged and triaged; escalating to postmortem.
rory: I ran a quick smoke against stable endpoint, all responses look healthy. also ran canary verification on other regions — good.
ben: preliminary root cause: misconfigured canary manifest. the rollout batch had incorrect route tag so ~30% routed to experimental instead of 5%. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rollouts/pulls/4829
sofia: mitigation checklist done: feature flag cut, verified traffic reroute, rolled back experimental deployment to previous tag. can we keep monitoring for 30m then handoff?
eve: CI guard note — our rollout pipeline currently allows >10% canary if manifest has explicit weight. adding a safeguard in the pipeline now (will open PR).
alex.m: severity assessment: S2 — widespread errors for subset of customers for ~8 minutes, degraded latency for 12 minutes. No data exfiltration or security issues.
sofia: assigning action items — ben to write postmortem, eve to add pipeline guard and FF runbook doc updates, rory to add automated smoke for router endpoint. I'll own runbook updates and final triage notes.
ben: starting postmortem draft in INC-2026-234. ETA EOD.
sofia: handing off monitoring to @rory in 30m. will update incident channel when I drop.
rory: got it, picking up watch. running long-run load test and will report back if anything spikes.
alex.m: thanks all — nice quick cutover. please include timeline + customer affected list in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident resolved (auto): status=monitoring, duration=00:22:15, resolved_by=sofia.
sofia: closing note: no active pages, marking as monitoring. will follow-up with postmortem link when ready.
